caption: Two identical white vases stand at different distances from a single lamp in a dark room, and the nearer one is lit far more brightly than the farther one.

sa.check: Two identical white vases stand in a dark room.
A single lamp lights them from different distances.
The nearer one is lit far more brightly than the farther one.
The far vase would brighten if moved toward the lamp.

pc.expect: Brightness falls off with distance from the lamp: the near vase is bright and the far one dim.
pc.fail: Both are equally bright; or the far one is brighter; or neither is lit with the lamp on.

pc.expect: Both vases are white; only their brightness differs.
pc.fail: One changes colour; or the far one is a different colour; or both change colour.

pc.expect: Each vase's shadow points away from the lamp.
pc.fail: Shadows point toward the lamp; or in different directions; or there are none.

pc.expect: The vases and the lamp stay put.
pc.fail: A vase slides; or the lamp moves by itself; or the lit side changes with nothing moving.
A third vase appears; or one vanishes; or the lamp duplicates.
The table changes; or the walls change; or the vases change shape.

note: Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
